stories.title: Boulder-based biotech company raises $87 million amid shift to vaccine development
stories.summary: VitriVax has nearly doubled its workforce since 2023, when the company was awarded a contract with the Department of Defense and funding from the Gates Foundation.

stories.title: DEA calls Aurora overdoses region's worst since five died in Commerce City in 2022
stories.summary: Two people died and three were hospitalized after taking a drug Aurora police say was laced with suspected fentanyl.

stories.title: Construction progresses on former VA campus in Denver starting with historic renovation
stories.summary: About 8% of the 493 units in the adapted building will be designated as income-restricted for those making no more than 60% of the area median income.

stories.title: State details data accessed from myColorado app, no timetable for going back online
stories.summary: The Office of Information Technology said "myDocuments" were involved, which include PDFs and photographs of passports, vehicle registrations and insurance cards.

stories.title: 'No wrong way to Opt Outside': Outdoor retailer to leave its doors closed on Black Friday
stories.summary: REI Co-op to close its doors on Black Friday, continuing a tradition that began in 2015. All REI stores, distribution centers, call centers and HQ will be closed.

stories.title: Northern Colorado senior center to open to all ages during certain times
stories.summary: The policy update allows children and teens to take part in recreational programs and services offered at the Fort Collins Senior Center.

stories.title: Man sentenced for sexually assaulting and attempting to kidnap a girl in 2025
stories.summary: The sexual assault and attempted kidnapping happened in the 6800 block of South Prince Way on April 19, 2025.

stories.title: 2 people indicted for stealing $40,000 worth of Pokémon and sports cards
stories.summary: Luis Barela and Sophia Leclair are alleged to have been part of an organized crime ring that operated in Colorado, Wyoming and Nebraska.

stories.title: Help combat hunger: Donate to 9Cares Colorado Shares to support local food banks
stories.summary: The 9Cares Colorado Shares food drive supports five food banks, providing meals to struggling families. One in eight Coloradans face food insecurity.

stories.title: 50 things to do in Colorado this Thanksgiving weekend
stories.summary: Colorado celebrates Thanksgiving and welcomes the holiday season with lightings, parades, "The Nutcracker" and "A Christmas Carol."

stories.title: Lafayette fences off multiple sites after discovery of another human bone fragment
stories.summary: Local historians are questioning the city's decision to relocate soil containing potential human remains without thoroughly sifting through it.

stories.title: Deion Sanders shrugs off hot-seat chatter as Colorado prepares for UCF amid coach's uncertain future
stories.summary: Deion Sanders is tuning out speculation about his future as Colorado's coach.
